observations: Two manual treadle sewing machine stands with wooden tops.
Cast iron legs featuring foot pedals and flywheels.
One table top has a blue marble-patterned finish with a printed ruler (photo 2).
One table top has a wood-grain patterned finish (photo 3).
The brand 'SUMO PREMIUM' is embossed on the foot pedals in photos 2 and 3.
The table top cutouts differ: photo 2 is for a standard sewing machine, photo 3 is for a weaving (overlocking) machine.

claims.evidence: Photos 2 and 3 show the specific cutouts required for a standard sewing machine and an overlocker (weaving machine) respectively.

risks.proof: Video showing the flywheel spinning freely when the treadle is operated.

risks.risk: Drive belts are not visible in any photo.
risks.proof: Photo showing the leather drive belts included with the stands.

risks.risk: Table tops may be made of low-density board prone to water damage or warping.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside and edges of the wooden tops.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle and flywheel in motion for both stands.
Photos of the underside of the table tops.
Confirmation if the drive belts are included in the price.
response.reason: The brand and specific types (sewing vs weaving) are clearly identified from the photos. While mechanical smoothness and completeness are unverified, the items can be priced at a base functional value.
